claims.text: The datasets used include EEG recordings of brain activity and behavioral data from language comprehension tasks.
Heterogeneous data types such as eye-tracking, self-paced reading, and ERP components are utilized to enhance understanding of human language processing.
The study emphasizes the use of multitask learning to analyze relationships between ERP components and behavioral data.
